  "defect_location": {
    "repo": "calcom/cal.com",
    "summary": "The contract is owned by packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45, where resolveHideBranding returns true whenever the organization/parent has branding hidden regardless of the entity's own column, and is exposed for events as shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile / shouldHideBrandingForEvent / ...ForTeamEvent / ...ForUserEvent (hideBranding.ts:85-181). Every page the customer books from consumes exactly that: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299-302, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199-202, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61-64 and :103-106, apps/web/lib/org/[orgSlug]/instant-meeting/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:85-88, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36-39, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-258 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58-63. The automations do not. packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, :274-276 and :433-435 compute `brandingDisabled = reminder.booking.eventType?.team ? !!team.hideBranding : !!reminder.booking.user?.hideBranding` — raw columns, with no organization/parent inheritance, and the data to do better is not even selected (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:164-207 selects only user.hideBranding and eventType.team.{parentId,hideBranding}, never team.parent.hideBranding nor the owner's profile/organization). That value is then handed to the renderers that stamp the vendor name: templates/emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-85 and templates/emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-82 append `${t(\"scheduling_by\")} ${APP_NAME}` unless isBrandingDisabled, and templates/customTemplate.ts:216-218 appends `Scheduling by ${APP_NAME}` (APP_NAME from packages/lib/constants.ts). The second wrong source is the entity itself: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 calls getHideBranding({ userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId }) — the WORKFLOW's owner rather than the booked event's owner/team — and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same off the routing form's owner, the value then travelling through reminderScheduler.ts:91-101/155-162/207-253 and emailReminderManager.ts:109-118/143-153 to the send.
